message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (June 18, 1815) resulted in roughly **23,000 total casualties**—killed, wounded, or missing—across both sides.  

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition (Wellington & Blücher) | ~22,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates; exact numbers vary slightly among contemporary reports and modern scholarship.
